lines.trans: Xingzi, when are we renewing our Twelve Singers contract? Our whole management team is waiting!
Didn't we hear earlier that your artist had no open dates and wouldn't be renewing?
Who ever said that? We have always partnered closely with you!
Let me tell you, we're turning down every other booking — our singer must be on Twelve Singers!
Please hold for just a moment. Chief editor's office, Xingzi speaking.
Xingzi, there was a tiny misunderstanding in our last two conversations!
Oh my goodness — this season is a total landslide victory!
These people are outrageous — talk about a complete one-eighty!
Right — once word got out that Xin Huimei and the Golden Class were reuniting, every agency came rushing over.
This season is already red-hot before airing a single frame; I truly didn't see this coming.
And I never imagined a superstar like Xin Huimei would care so deeply about our office's project.
Every last obstacle is settled!
